notes: Articles I-VIII cover the Conservative Reformation itself; IX-XIV are the Specific Theology (Original Sin, Person of Christ, Baptism, and the Lord's Supper in three printed articles: Thetically Stated p.585, Antithesis p.664, Objections p.755).
Each opener was validated against the printed page folio at the bottom of its chapter-opener page and the printed TOC.
Page-bottom footnotes remain inline at their page positions; the printed general index at the back was dropped (references only).
